statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder sees two charges of $79.99 each from 'AUDIOPEAK ELECTRONICS' posted 20 minutes apart and believes this is a duplicate charge for a single order.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: The cardholder emailed AudioPeak [5 days after the charges]. The merchant explained the two charges correspond to two separate orders with different products and different order numbers.
statement.requestedResolution: Reversal of one of the two $79.99 charges, believed to be a duplicate.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Medium — merchant may have valid defense documentation showing two distinct orders.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4834 (Point of Interaction Error).
